newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES FIRMER ON U.S. UNIT.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES FIRMER ON U.S. UNIT.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed Monday's session firmer against the U.S. dollar compared to Thursday despite intervention by the central bank to mop up excess foreign currency in the market, dealers said.

"There were inflows of U.S. dollars into the market -- I presume it was tobacco funds -- and the Zimbabwe dollar appreciated by about 0.22 percent (from its morning levels) to 11.2750/2850," one dealer said.
"It looks like the RBZ came in (buying U.S. dollars) because we came down a bit," he added.
But the local currency still finished firmer at 11.2850/2950 to the U.S. unit compared with Thursday's 11.2975/3075.

Against the crosses however it was quoted weaker; at 18.4500/4700 from 18.3865/4130 versus sterling; at 6.6300/6500 against the mark from 6.5390/5480 and at 2.5400/5600 from 2.5290/5330 against South Africa's rand.
